item.title: 66 slot machines seized, one charged in Venice illegal gambling bust
item.description: A Venice woman was arrested and 66 slot machines were seized in connection with a months-long investigation into multiple illegal gambling operations in Sarasota County, according to authorities.Taylor Swim, 28, was charged with maintaining a gambling house and possession of slot machines. She was taken into custody at 41 Social Club at 1978 S. Tamiami Trail in Venice, Jan. 28, according to the Sarasota County Sheriff’s Office. item.title: Hulk Hogan's Clearwater Beach estate to hit the market for $10.9M
item.description: The Clearwater Beach waterfront home that once belonged to legendary wrestler — and local — Hulk Hogan will be listed for sale Monday with an asking price of $10.98 million.The house is at 1040 Eldorado Ave. on the far north end of the barrier island. The sale does not include a cottage on the property which is being separated and getting its own tax ID. Hulk Hogan's home, which will be on the market Feb. 2, sits on the beach in a residential stretch of Clearwater Beach. Image courtesy of Coldwe

item.title: Tampa Bay architects predict slower real estate growth in 2026
item.description: The Tampa Bay area will continue to see real estate growth throughout 2026, but at a slower rate than previous years as developers face new economic challenges, a new survey says. The American Institute of Architects’ Tampa Bay chapter surveys member architects in the region each year for its annual Voices of Architecture survey, which aims to predict future trends in area real estate and construction activity. item.title: Growing Lakeland firm tops $1 billion in 2025 sales
item.description: Fort MyersPair of gas stations acquired A two-property 7-Eleven portfolio has sold for $10.62 million. The portfolio includes a shop in Fort Myers at 2977 Cleveland Ave. The 3,010-square-feet shop was built in 2019 and sits on a 2.13-acre site that includes a Mobil-branded gas station and a Wells Fargo ATM. item.description: A residential project intended to breathe new life into what the city calls the Limelight District on the edge of the Park East neighborhood made its first appearance before the city’s Development Review Committee Jan. 21.Dubbed 414 Lime Avenue, Homes by WestBay of Riverview seeks to build 41 attached single-family units on a 1.91-acre site at North Lime Avenue and Aspinwall Street. item.title: Manatee County to protect 1,500 acres of ranch land
item.description: Manatee County commissioners recently authorized the protection of more than 1,500 acres of agricultural land from development. The properties include 1,045 acres at Thundercloud Ranch and 483 acres at Mossy Island Ranch. item.title: $55M Fort Myers affordable housing project secures financing
item.description: A new affordable housing community for seniors is being built in Fort Myers through a partnership between two organizations. Miami-based developer Housing Trust Group is working with nonprofit AM Affordable Housing, founded by NBA Hall of Famer and Miami Heat legend Alonzo Mourning, to construct Legacy Park II.When complete, the Fort Myers community will include 130 apartments for adults 55 years old and up. item.title: USF College of Nursing receives $2M gift to fund scholarships
item.description: The University of South Florida’s College of Nursing has received a $2 million donation intended to help college graduates cover the costs of transitioning into a career in nursing.
